story: Hola, me llamo María López y vivo en 12 Oak Street, Brightwater. Mi teléfono es 0612 345 678. Somos 4: mi esposo, yo y dos hijos de 3 y 8 años. Ganamos 3.600 al mes. Pagamos 1.100 de renta y también la factura de calefacción. Mi esposo trabaja y yo estudio.
I'm Tom Baker, 30, I live alone in Brightwater and work full-time. I earn 3,000 a month and my rent is 900. Heating is included in my rent.
My name is Ruth Evans. I'm 67 and my husband is 70, we are both retired and live in Brightwater. Our pension is 1,900 a month. We own our home, so no rent, but we pay the gas heating bill.

This is Aisha Khan, call me on 07700 900 123 or aisha.k@example.com. I live at 4 Mill Lane, Brightwater. I'm a single mum, I work part-time and earn 1,450 a month. My daughter Zara is 2. Rent is 700 a month. I got an eviction notice last week.
We are a family of 3 in Brightwater: me, my partner and our son aged 10. I make 600 a week and my partner is unemployed. We pay 1,000 rent.
